description: E212 s0. Why the public store's index, or a dataset in it, is refused: one closed key each (public-store/v1/store.py OWN_CODES), one sentence each. `{dataset}` is the dataset's name as a person reads it; no sentence carries a code, a field name or a path. The per-source licence and policy sentences are E211's (vocabulary/v1/sample-index-words.json).

reasons.index-malformed: The list of what the public store holds could not be read, so {dataset} and every other dataset are refused.
reasons.dataset-repeated: {dataset} is listed more than once, so the list is refused until it is listed once.
reasons.key-repeated: A file of {dataset} has the same address as another file, so the list is refused.
reasons.key-outside-dataset: A file of {dataset} is not stored under its own dataset and checksum, so the list is refused.
reasons.records-differ: The catalogue records listed for {dataset} are not those of its sources, in their order, so the list is refused.
reasons.too-many-objects: {dataset} would hold more files than the store allows for one dataset, so the list is refused until that limit is ruled on.
